build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where two dynamic bars must touch each other
add_dynamic_bar: create a dynamic bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and angle
add_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle in the PHYRE scene at a specified position
update_task_relationships: define the task goal by setting two bodies must be touching using update_task
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to PRE_TWO_BALLS difficulty tier using set_meta
